title: Read the Badges
briefing: The Architect's Wing shows each room's height on a badge. Balance factor = left height minus right height. A room is safe at -1, 0 or +1; anything else strains the vault. Click every room whose balance factor breaks the rule, then press Submit.
hints: Balance factor = height(left child) - height(right child); a missing child counts as 0.
Two rooms here are strained: look for height differences of 2.
